mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for @TotalDamage@ magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @DaggerCooldownReduction@ seconds (@TooltipDaggerReduction@). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.

mBuff.mDescription:
VoracityWhenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last 3 seconds, her ability cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing @f1@ (+@f2@) (+@f3@) magic damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last @ResetWindow@ seconds, her Ability Cooldowns are reduced by @ResetCDR@ seconds.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_KatarinaPassive_Tooltip}}

Dagger slashes apply On-Hit Effects to champions.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina throws a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Katarina throws a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor>, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the target and @MaxBounces@ nearby enemies. The <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage and @ADDamageCalc@ physical damage, and applies @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds for @GrievousDuration@ seconds.

Total over @Duration@ seconds to each enemy: @TotalDamageCalc@ magic damage and @TotalADDamageCalc@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit and On-Attack effects at @OnHitRatio*100@% damage, and does not Critically Strike or apply Life Steal.
The physical damage additionally increases with Attack Speed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Death Lotus</titleLeft><mainText>Katarina is channeling her ultimate. Enemy champions stay in range at their peril!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> into the air directly above herself.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Katarina tosses a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> into the air and gains <speed>@MovespeedAmount@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @MovespeedDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Preparation</titleLeft><mainText>Katarina has increased Move Speed while her <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> is in the air.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
